patthana18.11:1.1: hetusampayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetusampayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana18.11:2.1: hetuvippayuttaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetuvippayutto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. hetuyā cha.
patthana18.11:3.1: hetusampayuttaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na hetuvippayutto na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. hetusahetuka dukahetuduke nahetusahetukaduka nahetudukaṃ
